scope: Coverage gap, not a reproduced kernel/native defect: poll constructors execute, but reference-poll is absent and pending readiness/rearm/removal effects lack a dedicated public boundary contract.
planned_boundary: reference-poll [arm|write|wait|cancel|drain|missing|quiet ...], bounded validated command sequences over owned nonblocking pipe; one-shot readiness/rearm, two cancellation CQEs, missing tag, EBADF, HUP/EOF and before-exit FD closure.
limits: Sequential deterministic readiness/cancel separation; no arrival/cancel race, multishot, SQPOLL, all masks/descriptors or independent review.
review_blocker: Supported child host unavailable; no retry/fallback authorized or attempted.
